releaseNotes: Cache retention test only; no accounting, project, invoice, contract, or PDF features changed.
After the new build passes its startup health check, the updater keeps the active app cache and the exact previous cache for rollback.
Other caches with the app-owned tha-app-v prefix are removed only after successful startup confirmation.
If startup health checks fail, rollback runs and cache cleanup is not performed.
Accounting records and unrelated browser caches are not modified.
